title: ranunculus aconitifolius proles intermedius
intro: Ranunculus aconitifolius proles intermedius, commonly known as the lesser celandine or pilewort, is a flowering plant belonging to the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, treating skin conditions, and alleviating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to inhibit histamine release, exhibit anti-inflammatory properties, and act as an expectorant, facilitating the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of Ranunculus aconitifolius proles intermedius include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
